name: PwC Game of Threats™
description: PwC's proprietary digital serious game for training C-suite executives and board members on cyber threat response. Simulates realistic cyber attack scenarios in a fast-paced, competitive game format where two teams take on attacker and defender roles. Participants make high-stakes decisions under extreme time pressure with incomplete information, building executive intuition for cyber crisis governance.
general_score_metric: scenario outcome score / decision effectiveness (outcome-based performance metrics)
reputation: Widely adopted executive-level cyber awareness game; used by major corporations and boards globally
notes: Available through PwC client engagements. Played in facilitated workshop settings. Designed to shift executive mental models from compliance to active cyber crisis leadership.
